research_mode: official ONS ArcGIS service and official Esri REST documentation only; query-contract audit; no target parcel result claimed

sources.name: ArcGIS REST Feature Service point-query contract
verified_claims: point filters support geometryType=esriGeometryPoint with comma-separated x,y geometry
inSR declares the input geometry spatial reference
esriSpatialRelIntersects is a supported spatial relationship
returnGeometry=false is supported when only attributes are required
limitations: the generic API contract does not prove a particular parcel-to-LSOA result
each target response still requires hash capture and an exactly-one-feature cardinality check

sources.publisher: Office for National Statistics Open Geography Portal
sources.name: LSOA 2021 BGC V5 layer exact schema and service capabilities
verified_claims: layer 0 is LSOA_2021_EW_BGC_V5 and has polygon geometry
the service spatial reference is EPSG:27700
LSOA21CD is a nine-character string field and LSOA21NM is a forty-character string field
the layer supports Query and JSON responses with maximum record count 2000
limitations: service metadata alone does not prove target-point containment
a point touching a boundary must fail closed unless exactly one feature is returned
